source: OurAirports register (public domain) joined to OpenStreetMap named amenity=parking (ODbL 1.0, attribution required)

gate.association_gate: a lot qualifies only ON_SITE within 1.5 km or NAMED_FOR_THE_AIRPORT; distance alone beyond 1.5 km is not association
gate.duplicate_names_collapsed: one physical car park is often several OSM objects sharing a name, so names are collapsed before counting

why: the POI extractor did not retain the OSM capacity, fee or parking tags, so any space count or price on this page would be invented
